cs.t: I use fairly high-end Sennheisers with semi-open backs and big ear cups at home. I find closed backs too isolating in most work environments, and these are not actively anti-noise, so these won't work without music playing. They are also too big and too expensive to carry around. When traveling or at customer sites, I use MEElectronics IEMs. These are reasonably priced, so I'm not worried about breaking or losing them. They are great on airplanes. They are small and often go unnoticed. The over-the-ear memory-wire configuration stays securely in my ears. I also use Comply foam tips and keep some extras with me in case the headphones end up on the airplane floor or some other place I don't want in my ears.
